name: What is the typical timeline for a major residential remodel?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for a major residential remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a major residential remodel varies significantly based on its scope and complexity. A small kitchen or bathroom update might take 4-8 weeks, while a whole-house renovation or significant addition could span 6-12 months or more. Key factors include design finalization, permitting in Los Angeles County, material lead times, and the availability of skilled tradespeople. We provide a detailed project schedule upfront, outlining each phase from demolition to final inspections, to keep you informed.
acceptedAnswer.description: Major residential remodels typically take 4-12 months, depending on scope, complexity, and permitting in your area.
